name: persian-text-guard
description: Persian text normalization and evasion-resistant profanity filtering for JavaScript and TypeScript. Folds Arabic/Persian look-alike letters, zero-width and bidi characters, and all three digit ranges, and catches the ways people get around a word list: spaced or dotted letters, held keys, leetspeak, filler symbols, Cyrillic look-alikes and Finglish. Finds every match with its position and censors messages with a fixed mask. Ships an optional curated Persian/Finglish/English word list of about 1,250 categorised entries.
author: Amirehsan Kohannasab

scripts.lint: npm run generate && eslint . && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.test: npm run generate && vitest run --exclude test/corpus.test.ts --exclude test/readme.test.ts
scripts.corpus: npm run generate && vitest run test/corpus.test.ts
scripts.test:readme: npm run build && vitest run test/readme.test.ts
scripts.bench: npm run build && node --import tsx bench/filter.bench.ts
